typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

percentOpen.description: The {@link Feature} that represents the PERCENT_OPEN sensor instrumented on the Control Valve.

excludeFeatures.description:
Use this field to specify the list of columns in the input data that should be excluded from model training.

If any of the values specified in this list are not columns in the input data, the pipe will ignore them, and
will proceed with training and inference with the remaining features.

doNotSparsify.description:
Flag to determine whether the model features will be sparsified based on the `featureWeights`.
This is applicable only when using an ElasticNet model. If the flag is set to `true`, the model will check the regularized coefficients of features.
Features with weights below the `minCoef` threshold will be excluded, and a new model will be trained without those features.

**Note**: This option allows for feature selection based on the importance of each feature.

minCoef.description:
Minimum coefficient size for significant features when using ElasticNet regression.
If the absolute value of the feature weight is smaller than `minCoef`, the feature will be considered insignificant and excluded.
This parameter ensures that only the most relevant features are considered in the model.

featureWeights.description:
A dictionary that stores the feature weights for the model after training.
These weights represent the influence of each feature in the model’s prediction.
The dictionary is automatically populated during model training and should not be manually set.
The weights depend on the type of regressor used (e.g., ElasticNet, LightGBM) and can be used for feature importance analysis.

checkDataCompleteness.description:
Flag to enable or disable data completeness checking during inference.
If set to `true`, the model will evaluate whether the available data for each feature meets a predefined completeness threshold.
Missing data in features will be assessed, and weighted scores will be used to determine whether the data for each feature is complete enough for accurate prediction.

If data completeness is insufficient, no prediction will be made.

dataCompletenessThreshold.description:
Minimum data completeness percentage required for making a prediction.
If the data completeness (based on feature weights) is below this threshold, the system will reject the prediction and may return an error or warning.

The completeness is measured based on the weighted importance of the features used for modeling. For example, a high importance feature with insufficient data might cause the system to discard the prediction.

missingFeatureMaxDuration.description:
Maximum allowable duration (in hours) of missing data before the feature is considered to have insufficient data.
This setting is used during inference to determine when the data for a feature is considered too sparse for reliable predictions.

For example, if a sensor has missing data for 12 consecutive hours, it will be flagged as missing, and its data will be excluded from the prediction process.

title:
`LegacyControlValvesModelable` extends `ControlValvesModelableBase` and provides a model framework for reconstructing control valve data using machine learning models such as LightGBM.

**Overview:**
- This entity is used in the context of modeling control valve systems.
- It supports reconstruction and inference processes, providing a robust way to model control valve data while considering feature weights, data completeness, and model sparsification.
- It integrates various machine learning techniques and pipelines for reconstructing control valve sensor data using LightGBM and ElasticNet regressors.

**Attributes:**
